item.text: {"issues":[{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Reports broadly describe app crashes or sudden failures, with a few examples mentioning unrelated playback behavior or a data leak.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["4cd1f1f1-a01d-427e-9e81-8b1f7873f729","e51b39a7-83e5-4b52-a006-6a6ce176d3ff"],"issue_id":"TMP_PLAYBACK_05","issue_name":"App crashes and stops working"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Most examples describe songs failing to start or play, while others concern playback restrictions, background behavior, or vague glitches.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["d3ebec48-c3cc-4d91-ac7d-e60442dc4b34","929c097b-f5c7-4485-98e3-0fd068d17e65"],"issue_id":"TMP_PLAYBACK_06","issue_name":"Songs fail to start playing"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Examples report playback stopping, restarting, or selecting unexpected songs, alongside complaints about choosing specific tracks and vague app quality.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["aa57c70a-3176-4800-bb58-3863c1445d7d","be1c9c8f-97e3-4633-8b25-72c9c3f9f016","c9e9eab9-75b2-4738-b6bf-051a61fdad51"],"issue_id":"TMP_PLAYBACK_07","issue_name":"Playback stops or behaves unexpectedly"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Most examples report downloaded content disappearing and needing to be downloaded again, while a few describe logout or automatic podcast completion and deletion.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["1dd69e0a-2a12-4915-8d69-7b63078a9e56","73a4b27f-1be9-42db-a198-c0d7c39575cb"],"issue_id":"TMP_DOWNLOADS_01","issue_name":"Downloaded content disappears"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Most examples say downloaded music cannot be played offline, while some concern offline access requiring login or general app praise.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["293db6a1-938e-4bf7-9eef-29a6af153d13"],"issue_id":"TMP_DOWNLOADS_02","issue_name":"Downloaded music unavailable offline"}]}
